Definition: from G4314 and G394; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult:--in conference add, confer.
BiblicalUsage: Prosanatithemi means to lay something beside, to impart or add in conference. Paul says that after God revealed His Son in him, he conferred not with flesh and blood, and that those who seemed to be pillars added nothing to him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's point is plain: his gospel came from God, not from a committee, and no man's addition could improve it.
